messages.subject: cpp file for one multivariate distribution
parts:
Dear all,

I wrote one cpp file for one simple multivariate distribution model. It fails to compile. Would you mind checking and correcting it? Thank you.

Here is the model description:
The state variable x is a 2*100 array, in which 100 is the step of time series and 2 is the two dimensional variables.
For simplicity, those two variables are fixed across all time steps: the first variable equals to the exponential of one parameter "th1" across
100 time steps while the other variable equals to another parameter "th2" across 100 time steps.

y is the observation of the state variable x, which is also a 2*100 array. For each time step t (the column t of y), the first element
of y equals to a sample from a normal distribution with mean=x[0][t] and sd=sdy[1], and the second element of y equals to another sample
of a normal distribution with mean=x[1][t] and sd=sdy[2] where sdy is a parameter vector with two elements. 

Here is my cpp file:

#include <TMB.hpp>
template<class Type>
Type objective_function<Type>::operator() ()
{
DATA_ARRAY(y); /* 2*100 */
PARAMETER(th1);
PARAMETER(th2);
PARAMETER_VECTOR(sdy);
PARAMETER_ARRAY(x); /* State variable in 2*100 */
int timeSteps=y.dim[1]; /*here is 100 */
int stateDim=y.dim[0]; /*here is 2 */
/*define x*/
int x[0][]=exp(th1);
int x[1][]=th2;
/* Define likelihood: only observation error */
Type ans=0;
for(int i=0;i<timeSteps;i++)
  ans-=dnorm(vector<Type>(y.col(i)),vector<Type>(x.col(i)),sdy,1).sum(); 
return ans;
}

Best,
Jing Jiao
